document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The walls tell a bizarre story: strange ceremonies 
are presided over by a tall man with glowing eyes, 
while, in the background, there are distorted, 
kangaroo-like creatures bending forward as they gaze into open 
sarcophagi. The next section shows mummies rising from the 
dead and taking their place beside the odd animals. Return to 
419.
(419)
